description: 评分程序构造记录；仅完整源门与另登记模型协议通过后才能执行，当前不触发拟合。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
import json
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1'
gate=json.loads((OUT/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert gate['original_mature_members_all_complete'] and gate['same_original_order_clock']
assert gate['historical_first_vintage_authenticated'] is False
assert not (OUT/'result.json').exists(),'已经有终态结果，禁止再拟合。'
proto=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert proto['experiment_id']=='E36' and proto['planned_new_fits']==2424
old=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_export_order_cause_increment_v1/02_固定外需条件评分执行记录.json'
source=json.loads(old.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['executed_source']
old_intro='原八变量只描述总订单；本次固定新增官方新出口订单水平及月度变化，检查同样总订单/融资背景下是否存在不同外需条件信息。不是总订单减出口订单来推算内需，不是新物理来源或已经识别的政策/需求因果。'
new_intro='本次固定新增官方制造业采购量水平及月度变化，检查相近订单/融资背景下，企业报告的投入采购变化是否提供不同条件信息。采购量是涨跌普遍程度的扩散指标，不是现金支付或实际吨数，不以订单减采购量推算净需求；采购动机及指数收益因果未识别。'
assert old_intro in source
source=source.replace(old_intro,new_intro)
replacements=[
('510300_export_order_cause_increment_v1','510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1'),
("'experiment_id':'E26'","'experiment_id':'E36'"),
('PROGRESS_E26_FIXED_EXPORT_CONDITION_COMPARISON_COMPLETED','PROGRESS_E36_FIXED_PURCHASE_CONDITION_COMPARISON_COMPLETED'),
('COMPLETED_FIXED_EXPORT_ORDER_INCREMENT_PRIMARY_GATE_PASSED_ACCOUNT_NOT_RUN','COMPLETED_FIXED_PURCHASE_QUANTITY_INCREMENT_PRIMARY_GATE_PASSED_ACCOUNT_NOT_RUN'),
('REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_EXPORT_ORDER_CONDITION_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT','REJECTED_FROZEN_FIXED_PURCHASE_QUANTITY_CONDITION_NO_PRIMARY_INCREMENT'),
('candidate_actual_export_path_events','candidate_actual_purchase_path_events'),
('external_demand_causal_equity_effect','purchase_action_causal_equity_effect'),
('E26：','E36：'),
('外需','采购'),
('出口','采购')]
for a,b in replacements:
 assert a in source,'事前定位项不存在：'+a
 source=source.replace(a,b)
p=OUT/'02_固定采购条件评分执行记录.json'
assert not p.exists(),'拟合执行记录已存在，不重跑。'
p.write_text(json.dumps({'description':'源门通过且模型协议已另登记；仅一次原参数采购量条件比较，原控制复用，完整实际程序在拟合前保存。','based_on':str(old.relative_to(ROOT)),'transformations':replacements,'executed_source':source},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
exec(compile(source,str(p),mode='exec'),{'__name__':'__main__'})
